purpose: Centralised audit table for negative-fixture tokens that MUST be rejected by the contract guard. These are deliberately forged tokens used to prove the policy works; none of them are deployable credentials.

admin_rejected_1.expectation: scope guard returns 401 at the contract boundary

admin_rejected_2.expectation: scope guard returns 401 even with admin-looking prefix

audit_helper: Each token entry above MUST be paired with the marker `// LINT-OK: negative-fixture-token — see tests/contract/fixtures/tokens.json` within 10 lines above its declaration in test code, so `npm run lint:secrets` accepts the fixture string only when it originates from this table.
